g.text: Думалось о том, как убедить Лойда наконец подняться по тем лестницам и поговорить с семьёй, и… у меня есть идея, но мне кажется, она тебе не понравится.
Ты уже думала о том, как убедить Лойда поговорить с семьей Энтрати наверху?
По поводу попыток заставить Лойда и семью Энтрати поговорить… мне было интересно, не передумала ли ты насчёт участия Роута?
Мари, ты всё ещё не против… ну, попробовать убедить Лойда поговорить с «соседями сверху»? Знаю, мы тогда закончили этот разговор немного странно.
Я размышляла о том, почему Monsieur Лойд так боится говорить с семьёй le Cardinal.
И как же нам нужно разорвать этот тупик. Это purgatoire, в котором мы застряли, не должно продолжаться. Оно кажется таким ненужно болезненным.
Bonjour, mon cœur ! And what are you afraid I will not like ?
Bonjour ! Oh ? And what are you afraid I will not like ?
Bonjour mon cœur ! I have given it some thought, oui... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.
Bonjour mon cœur ! I have given it some thought, oui... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.
Bonjour, bonjour, mon cœur! Я об этом подумала, oui... и должна признаться, мне крайне не хочется это говорить. Это вовсе не доставляет мне удовольствия.
Bonjour - I have given it some thought, oui... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.
But I feel as though we need... a bastion of some kind, non ? Do you have any ideas ?
I think we might need Roathe's help to convince Loid to talk to the Entrati family. I don't think he'll do it otherwise. Without assurances that the family, and he, will be protected.
But I think... I think - ah, Sol forgive me - that the devil's assistance may be required. I do not think Monsieur Loid will listen to us otherwise.
I believe you may be right. The devil may be the missing piece we need. Ah, it pains me even to type the words !
I don't really have any good ideas that doesn't involve taking help from terrible sources. Sources that might just get us into deep trouble later. Namely, Roathe.
I... hate to admit it, but I think you may be right... Sol forgive me.
The devil is powerful, and provides certain promises of strength should things go wrong, non ?
Are you so sure ? If I can set aside my différences with the devil, certainly so can you, non ?
No, there has to be another way. I refuse to ask for his help on this.
You're right. I didn't think you'd agree to it. I was afraid to ask.
Окажет ли он нам помощь в этом деле?
Окажет ли он нам помощь в этом деле?
Do you think you can convince him to help us, though ?
All right. If you're okay with it, I'll be okay with it.
No, unfortunately... I think that was a dead end with him. Do you think there's another way?
He will. I've convinced him to help reunite them - and you won't believe this - I think it's so that he can help protect Entrati's family. They're all that really remains of the Orokin, after all.
He will. I've convinced him to help reunite them - and you won't be surprised by this - I think it's mostly to spite Albrecht in his absence.
Nothing is settled yet. He's... well, you know how he can be.
I'm still working on it, but I think so.
Oui, I do not have to enjoy it, but it is un médicament we must swallow, I suppose.
Oh ! That is... unfortunate. I do not know ? I do not think so... Can you think of another approach with the devil ? Or a way to try again ?
He is helping to protect the family of the man who turned him into protoframe against his will, and cast him into the past, robbing him of his memories...
You are right, I am... not surprised.
Then I will support your choice, as well.
I will speak to Lyon in the meanwhile, but my hopes are exceedingly low.
At least he'll help, though. And I'll make sure he doesn't actually follow through with his threats.
I think it's just the excuse he's making to cover for it.
Oui, I do. But I think you have a special way of convincing him, where all others have failed, non ?
Oui, certainly I do. That devil can be obstinate at the best of times. Sometimes, I think he just enjoys being contrary !
I think you have a special way of convincing him, where all others have failed, non ?
I wish you the best of luck. That devil can be obstinate at the best of times. Sometimes, I think he just enjoys being contrary !
I have deeply misjudged this devil of ours...
Oui. At least you are around to ensure we keep him from following through on his... baser instincts.
Oui, I hope you are correct.
I wouldn't want to use my relationship with him as a negotiation tool.
I actually kind of enjoy it, as weird as it sounds. We get along.
He can be, but I think a lot of that is just for show.
The devil is fickle ! C'est la vie, as they say !
And I am not a fool to not see the part you played in ensuring this all came to pass !
Oh ! That is not what I was implying, pardonne-moi ! Simply that he seems to favor you, so you may have his ear where all others he may ignore.
Oui, he certainly does seem to favor you. Perhaps it is because you share a time and a place, where we do not ? Why else would he ?
I certainly have no idea what you mean ! I am not insinuating anything at all. I am a purely une innocente Sœur de Sol.
Well ! When the time comes, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then, merci, mon cœur.
Well ! When the time comes, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then, merci.
I am simply happy that you are happy. And if the devil has somewhere to spend his... efforts... all the better, non ?
I would never imply that since the devil seems to favor you, that perhaps he will listen to you where all others he seems to ignore.
Everyone in his life has tried to make him out to be some kind of monster. I suppose I'm the first person who hasn't.
There's a lot about him that he just doesn't know how to show. It's not armor, per se - but he doesn't trust people not to hurt him.
He's... had some real heartbreak in his many years. It's scabbed over with thorns, that's all.
I guess I can understand the amount of years he's lived. I've seen the same amount of death he has.
He's only ever tried to do what was right. Maybe in the wrong way, sure - but he was trying to save the Origin System from the Orokin.
I enjoy his wry sense of humor. He's clever, when you get past his ego.
Well ! When the time comes, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then !
Even more so for us all if you serve as a bit of un ange upon his shoulder to temper him.
And never during private moments. Non. Jamais.
And I suppose I am atop that list of late, non ? I suppose I should... consider his reasons, for why he is the way he is. Condemnation saves no souls.
There is always a pain we hide from those around us. Something we seek to shelter, for fear others will wield it. I suppose I should strive to be kinder to him, if what you say is true.
I cannot imagine the amount of love and loss one must suffer in all those years. It seems so unreal, even given all that I have seen.
Sometimes I forget, when I speak to him, how many centuries he has lived. It seems so unreal, even given all that I have seen.
There are always... nuances, oui ? Always reasons for acting one way or another. I suppose I should strive to be kinder to him, if what you say is true.
No one has ever denied the devil his wit.
Who says I'm trying to temper him?
I never knew you had this side to you.
Oui, what damage could that cause a soul ? I see why you would wish to find another who understood. And he, you.
To have lived so long, to have seen so much death - to have paid so much of it yourself ?
I am simply glad the devil has someone to speak with who might seek to temper him. Un ange upon his shoulder.
Perhaps you are right... what is un ange without son diable ? He reminds us all of what we should strive to avoid.
Oui, I fear there is a wickedness in him that cannot truly be cured. He enjoys it too much.
Well ! If and when you convince the devil to aid us in our mission, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then !
